rows.grounds: indeclinable particle introducing an additional point
bahuvrīhi compound bhakta+eka+gātraḥ qualifying tvam; tvam is the addressed subject
imperative bhava followed by quotative iti marking the content of the request
verb of entreaty with speaker as subject and mām as object
object of abhyarthaye, referring to the speaker

items.question: What request for single-minded devotion does the speaker make of the addressee?
premises: The speaker addresses the other as one to become devotion-one-limbed.
The imperative bhava expresses a desired state of being.
The speaker explicitly entreats this state for themselves.
items.inference: The speaker asks the addressee to become wholly devoted to them as a single-minded devotee.
uncertainties: The precise nuance of gātra in the compound bhakta+eka+gātraḥ (limb, body, or aspect) is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Moreover, I entreat you: be one whose sole limb is devotion to me.
